memories.memory: Make triggers and steps concrete, not vague timing.
Define what counts by its effect, not by a closed list or hard exclusions.
Give every rule its intent, so the AI can apply it to cases the rule doesn't name.
Keep instructions harness-neutral, so the same files work in any AI tool.
Build file paths in instructions from a variable, so they work for every user and harness.
Start with the simplest rule that does the job, and add detail only when it proves needed.
